description: The pie chart, titled “Token Routing Distribution (Fed...”, visually represents the proportional allocation of token routing across three distinct categories in a federated learning system: LOCAL, LLM, and EDGE_P2P. The largest segment, colored green and labeled “LOCAL”, accounts for 94.5% of the total, indicating that the vast majority of token routing occurs locally. The second largest segment, colored red and labeled “LLM”, represents 3.9% of the distribution, suggesting a modest share routed to large language models. The smallest segment, colored blue and labeled “EDGE_P2P”, constitutes only 1.6%, reflecting minimal peer-to-peer edge routing. The chart uses an exploded slice design for the two smaller segments (LLM and EDGE_P2P) to emphasize their relative proportions against the dominant LOCAL category. Percentages are clearly labeled within each slice, and the overall distribution underscores a highly centralized routing pattern with minimal offloading to external or peer-based systems.
